entries.description: Moyne Ross research on commercial property and capital: search and cite 49 Capital Made Physical papers and 103 Technical Library pages on building elements and spaces to the section, the Capital Register and MR Index methodology, and a sample Capital Strategy.
representativeQueries: should we refurbish or redevelop an ageing 1970s office
is deferred maintenance a form of debt
who pays for make good and dilapidations at lease end
how do MEES and EPC rules affect letting offices in England
what does a ten-year capital plan for a warehouse contain
how do NABERS ratings and disclosure affect commercial property in Australia
what is the MR Index and how are its bands read
what should vendor due diligence on a commercial building cover
what causes horizontal cracking in a brick cavity wall
how serious is corroding reinforcement in a car park slab
when is a membrane roof due for replacement rather than repair

entries.description: Answer capital-planning and building-element questions for commercial and multi-unit buildings from Moyne Ross research and the Technical Library, cited to the section, with limitations carried through.
representativeQueries: what drives capital expenditure in an ageing office building
when does a building become obsolete
how should a capex plan treat uncertainty
cite the research on deferred maintenance

entries.description: Help a person who asks for one to request a Moyne Ross Capital Strategy for a commercial or multi-unit building, with only the details they give.
representativeQueries: I want a ten-year capital plan for my office building
how do I get a capital strategy for a warehouse in the UK
